intro.text: "Icy" Ben Oldson, a criminal Wax caught in the Roughs.

items.text: Right after the arrest, Wayne banged some beer bottles on a table, so the beer foamed up and drenched Wax when he flicked the caps off with Allomancy. Wayne pulled the trick many more times, and Wax thinks it was the first time he truly saw Wayne smile. Wayne retold the story over a beer with Wax in Bilming in 348 PC.
